newsitem.title: USA: GelTex cholesterol reducer is patented.
newsitem.headline: GelTex cholesterol reducer is patented.

text.p: GelTex Pharmaceuticals Inc said it received a U.S. patent covering CholestaGel, its cholesterol reducer.
CholestaGel, which is in Phase II clinical trials, is an oral, polymer-based drug to treat elevated cholesterol levels, the company said in a statement released Monday.

The patent covers the use of a wide range of polymeric materials including CholestaGel to reduce blood cholesterol levels by binding polymers to bile acids in the digestive system and preventing their reabsorption into the bloodstream.
